What you will be doing New Graduate Surgical Technologist Residency Program Variable Shifts Department Placement: Variable New Grad Hourly Rate: $44.97 Anticipated Program Start Date: October 5th, 2026 The Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) Surgical Technologist Residency Program is designed for new graduate Surgical Technologists transitioning from student to novice surgical technologist in the operating room environment. HSS is committed to supporting new perioperative professionals through a structured learning experience that combines hands-on clinical training, mentorship, and professional development. This program is designed to build the foundational skills necessary to succeed in the highly specialized orthopedic surgical environment at HSS. The Surgical Technologist Residency Program is a twelve-month structured program from the date of hire. Residents work under the direct supervision of the Professional Development team and experienced clinical preceptors , receiving individualized clinical instruction, mentorship, and competency-based training. “The first six months of the program focuses on completing clinical orientation. Months six through twelve emphasize mentorship and the continued development of clinical skills and knowledge Throughout the program, residents gain experience in the perioperative environment while developing technical skills, sterile technique expertise, and procedural knowledge required to support orthopedic surgical teams. Clinical training and department placement may vary based on operational needs and learning opportunities. The clinical orientation process is structured with progressive learning objectives designed to support the development of surgical technologists in a high-acuity operating room setting. Residents receive continuous feedback and evaluation from clinical preceptors, the Professional Development team, and departmental leadership to support their transition into independent practice. Mandatory monthly meetings and educational sessions provide residents the opportunities for knowledge building, shared learning, mentorship, and professional growth. The goal of the program is to ensure residents develop the confidence, technical skills, and clinical judgment necessary to succeed as a Surgical Technologist at HSS. Program Requirements Candidates must meet the following qualifications: Must be a recent graduate of an accredited Surgical Technologist program , with graduation no earlier than May 2026 Must have obtained Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) certification (required) Must hold or obtain Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association by the start date Ability to work variable shifts and rotating schedules Ability to work in multiple surgical service lines or departments based on program needs Commitment to successfully complete the twelve-month Surgical Technologist Residency Program Applicants can check the status of their application via the HSS Careers Website . Non-Discrimination Policy Hospital for Special Surgery is committed to providing high quality care and skilled, compassionate, reliable service to our community in a safe and healing environment. What you will be doing Job Description Administrative Nursing Supervisor Full-Time Weekend Rotation Overview: The practice of the profession of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined in New York State as diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems through case finding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens prescribed by a licensed practitioner. The HSS Registered Nurse provides and ensures comprehensive nursing care to patients/families, using the nursing process and appropriate standards of care in accordance with the philosophy of Hospital for Special Surgery, the Division of Nursing, the ANA Code of Ethics and regulatory bodies. The Administrative Nursing Coordinator serves as a liaison between hospital administration, nursing leadership and management and the clinical teams. Additionally, they provide managerial support and oversight to the nursing units ensuring that day-to-day operational standards are met. This includes but is not limited to identifying patient service requirements, ensuring safe and fiscally responsible unit staffing, maintaining the efficient delivery of services and safe patient outcomes and the adherence to established hospital policies and procedures. Passion Commitment to achieving higher levels of performance both personally and for the organization. Demonstrates focus and alignment with the organizational goal. Displays the desire to be a lifelong learner. Self-motivated and proactive individual, driven to create and achieve result. Teamwork Demonstrates the necessary skills for team building, including open communication and promotion of a collegial atmosphere. Exhibits a high degree of critical thinking with the capacity to serve as a leader in a fast-paced, challenging environment. Collaborates effectively with the interprofessional teams . Promotes employee engagement and collegiality. Excellence Demonstrates an understanding of Magnet Nursing principles and the ability to operationalize them. Works collaboratively with Patient Care Directors and other nursing management to ensure appropriate, efficient and cost-effective staffing. Coordinates services within and outside the Department of Nursing to ensure the appropriate placement of patients, their therapeutic regimen, and provision of service to their families. Expedites and streamlines the Admission and Discharge of patients throughout the continuum of care, fostering efficient throughput. Promotes patient and family centered care in a healing environment. Delivers exemplary, world-class customer service. Creativity Supports an environment that encourages ‘out of the box’ thinking. Maintains current knowledge of evidenced-base practice. Creates an environment leading to innovation. Integrity Maintains confidentiality and loyalty. Encourages honesty and open communication. Leads by example. Demonstrates cultural competency and diversity appreciation when engaging with patients, visitors, co-workers and other customers. Requirements BSN from an accredited school of nursing required, Masters in Nursing Preferred NYS RN license and registration required AHA BLS, ACLS, PALs certification required 5+ years of nursing experience required Applicable clinical leadership or management experience preferred Specialty Nurses Certification (RN-BC, ONC, CCRN, NE-BC, NEA-BC) preferred Non-Discrimination Policy Hospital for Special Surgery is committed to providing high quality care and skilled, compassionate, reliable service to our community in a safe and healing environment. What you will be doing JOB DESCRIPTION Responsibilities: Program & Communication Strategy Understand the required components of data collection (PROMS - HOOS,JR /KOOS,JR and PROMIS-Global -10, Contralateral joint pain, Back pain, and Narcotics usage) Work with relevant stakeholders to develop impactful outreach strategies, including frequency of outreach and customization of messaging Share best practices with relevant stakeholders and codify approach Patient Engagement & Data Collection Enter data responses to questionnaires into the electronic database/ EMR Prepare and send mailings and emails of follow-up questionnaires Call patients to follow-up with questionnaires and enter responses Act as a liaison between surgeons and patients regarding opportunities to increase collection Assist in generating reports and summary data Assist with coordinating meetings with relevant stakeholders to review data The successful applicant for the position will be a motivated and organized individual who is able to perform a variety of different tasks essential to achieving our collection goals. What you will be doing Job Description: Research Technician - Theresa Wampler-Muskardin Lab Department/Service : Research Institute, Rheumatology Job Start Date : ASAP Specific Duties : Administration: (10%): Maintain standard operating protocols, list of reagents, study initiatives, assist with IACUC applications Supervises and trains undergraduate students, medical students and residents in standard operating protocols Provides weekly update at laboratory meetings Autoimmunity Research (90%): Works closely with Principal Investigator in the design and execution of translational studies in autoimmune disease. Performs in vitro studies, which will include growing human cell lines and primary cells, with subsequent analysis of gene and protein expression. Studies may also include genotyping and flow cytometry, and in vivo mouse experiments. Animal studies will incorporate use of mouse models of autoimmunity. Technician will be responsible for assisting in surgical procedures, providing animal care, and tissue harvesting techniques and post euthanasia processing. Clinical studies will involve interaction with the clinical coordinators for collection of patient samples, and processing the samples. The technician will interact with the research clinical coordinator and research assistants to cross-reference laboratory studies with clinical variables and outcomes. Education : Bachelor’s Degree, biology, chemistry, or other relevant biomedical area Skills required : Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong customer service orientation. Proficient use of computers and software. Experience in human cell culture and cell purifications preferred. Experience in murine handling and experiments preferred. Skills Preferred: Knowledge of Orthopedic and/or Rheumatologic terminology is a plus.
